notes:
FieldStitch 1.5.3 - full CPU use:
- Processing workers now tell Windows they are not background work. Windows 11 throttles windowless background processes ("efficiency mode"), which can hold them to the slower efficiency cores at low clock speeds.
- The log's timing summary now shows how busy the CPU was during each step, so slow steps are easy to spot.
Includes 1.5.2: matching slowdown fix, the CPU keeps all workers when the graphics card helps, faster track building, threaded GeoTIFF writing.
